text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
R-Rice... ran all the way to the end!
I got to run in my debut race...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Thanks!
O-Oh...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Onee-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe. Please continue to...
take good care of Rice...!

—And so, together with Rice Shower,
I took that very first step forward.
A few days later...
On this day, I visited the racecourse with Rice Shower once again.
I came here thinking this experience would surely help me get to know the opponents I'll be facing, but—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wah... There are so many people.
It's just like during a GⅠ...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? But aren't you saying
there are no GII or GIII races today...?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Mihono Bourbon!
What incredible presence for a Make Debut race!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Bourbon-san.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rapidly closing the gap, she surges straight to the front!
Without slowing down for a second, she just keeps pressing ahead!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Holding the lead all the way, Mihono Bourbon crosses the fiiiiiinish line!
(Waaaaahhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I can't wait for next year's Classics.
I'm definitely cheering for Mihono Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Our future Triple Crown Umamusume!
Let's go watch every single one of Bourbon's races!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
......Everyone who watched
Bourbon-san run has a smile on their face.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The cheering is way louder...
than it was for Rice's race...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Can Rice really do it, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fweh!? Big Brother!?
choice_data_list: You can do it, Rice Shower!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fweh!? Big Sister!?
choice_data_list: You can do it, Rice Shower!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Your voice is like magic, Onii-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Your voice is like magic, Onee-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Even with things that seem totally impossible,
you just make me feel... like maybe I actually can.
choice_data_list: How about you try entering the Classic races too, Rice?
Do you want to try entering the Classic races too, Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...The Classic races.

—Entering the Classic races means
clashing against the Umamusume
who debuted in the very same year.

If it were Rice Shower, she would be competing
on the same stage as Mihono Bourbon, but—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Can even someone like Rice... catch up?
To that... back...
choice_data_list: If it's Rice Shower, she can do it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...You always believe
in Rice, don't you, Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "...You always believe in Rice, don't you, Big Sis?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...All right. I'll give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it's a little scary, but...
I don't wanna stay a useless girl who can never change.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice will... try her best to catch up.
...To Bourbon-san.

And on that day, I made a promise with Rice Shower
to take on the Classic races together.

First, to the Spring Stakes.
We decided to head for the prep race
on the road to the Triple Crown.
